signals.usability_note: Clear view of a two-story split-level house frontage with driveway and lawn; a blue pickup in the foreground partially blocks the street view but not the house.
signals.notes: Mature trees shade the property, a stone retaining wall borders the front lawn, and the two pickups are ordinary personal vehicles with no commercial lettering or equipment; the blue one is parked on the street and the dark one is in the driveway.
